items.title: The complement of a closed point in a separated irreducible positive-dimensional scheme over a field is not proper
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a separated irreducible scheme X over a field of dimension greater than zero, the open subscheme obtained by deleting a closed point is not proper over k. The proof observes that irreducibility makes U = X setminus {x} fail to be closed in X, hence the open immersion U -> X is not a closed immersion and therefore not proper; since X is separated, the closedness criterion for images of proper schemes then shows that U -> Spec(k) cannot be proper either (proof lines 9195-9198). H2: the argument is short but genuinely two-step, and the separatedness hypothesis is used exactly in the second step.
